text:
Type: patterned flatwoven area rug
Use: adding a bold accent underfoot; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, retro
Materials: flat weave, smooth tightly woven yarn
Colors: bright mustard yellow, off-white
Shape: rectangle with an all-over white ogee trellis pattern, flat thin profile, crisp edges, medium-large, graphic and bold
Feel: cheerful, sunny, lively
Goes with: white or grey walls, grey sofas, light wood, black accents; Scandinavian or modern living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
